title: Standardization of Licensing Application and Certification Procedures
summary: The licensing process is standardized through specific forms (Form-Ka, Form-Kha, Form-Ga, Form-Cha) that mandate applicant compliance with the 2016 rules. These forms serve as the procedural interface between the applicant and the licensing authority, ensuring legal accountability.

evolution.procedure: Standardized application forms were introduced to formalize the licensing process, requiring applicants to certify their understanding of and compliance with the 2016 rules.

timeline.change: Establishment of the legal transition and procedural continuity.
